Norse longhouse on fjord's edge, snow thick on turf roof. Smoke curls from roof-hole into grey dawn. Ice forms at shoreline around beached knarr. Frost-rimed shields hang outside, breath-fog visible.

Urartu fortress of Erebuni crowns volcanic ridge, massive basalt blocks dusted with snow. Wind screams across ramparts. Armenian highlands stretch white beyond. Iron spearpoints glint in cold light, guards' breath steaming.
Scythian kurgan burial in winter steppe. Frozen earth mounded high, gold ornaments gleaming in weak sun. Felt tents circle the tomb. Horses stamp, breath clouding. Endless white plain meets grey sky.
Gobekli Tepe limestone pillars stand against Anatolian dawn, frost coating carved animals. Cold rain turns to sleet. Stone circles emerge from highland mist. Workers' fires smoke weakly in thin air.

Tang Dynasty palace courtyard blanketed in snow, red pillars stark against white. Frozen lotus pond mirrors pale sky. Silk-robed officials hurry through cold corridors, breath visible. Distant mountains loom white.

Pictish broch tower on Scottish headland, snowfall heavy against grey stone. Sea beyond churns dark. Smoke escapes through roof opening. Carved symbol stones half-buried in drifts, wind howling through gaps.

Tiwanaku gateway stands stark on Altiplano plateau, thirteen thousand feet high. Snow dusts megalithic stones. Thin air burns lungs. Lake Titicaca gleams frozen beyond. Llamas cluster near stone walls, ice-wind relentless.

Hittite Hattusa lion gate frost-covered, massive stone lions white-rimmed. Mountain wind howls through empty Anatolian capital. Grey winter sky presses down. Cyclopean walls disappear into snow squalls, abandoned temples echoing.

Xiongnu winter camp on Mongolian steppe, felt yurts smoke-stained and snow-laden. Central fire pit glows. Bronze cauldrons steam. Horses huddle in rope corrals. Stars brilliant above frozen grassland, breath freezing instantly.

Stonehenge at winter solstice dawn, sarsen stones ice-coated. Frost blankets Salisbury Plain. Pale sun rises through trilithons, breath-fog thick. Priests in wool cloaks watch alignment, ground frozen solid beneath.

Rare snowfall on Babylon's Ishtar Gate, glazed blue bricks dusted white. Ziggurat of Etemenanki rises frost-covered beyond. Date palms sag under unaccustomed weight. Temple priests huddle, breath visible in sacred corridors.

Tibetan monastery clings to Himalayan cliff, prayer flags frozen stiff. Butter lamps flicker in thin air. Monks in wool robes chant, breath steaming. Snow-covered peaks surround. Yak-butter tea steams in bronze bowls.

Hallstatt Celtic hillfort in Alpine winter, timber-laced stone walls buried in snow. Salt miners descend into frozen shafts, bronze tools glinting. Smoke rises from thatched longhouses. Iron swords stacked near gates, mountain passes impassable.

Persepolis audience hall under rare Persian snow, limestone columns ghostly white. Achaemenid guards in felt cloaks stamp frozen feet. Relief carvings frost-etched. Zagros Mountains vanish in grey squalls, braziers smoking weakly inside.

Catalhoyuk rooftops snow-covered, ladder-holes breathing smoke into Anatolian winter sky. Flatroofed mud-brick houses cluster tight. Stars brilliant overhead. Obsidian blades stacked inside, animal hides draped across frozen doorways, breath-fog thick.

Norse trading post on Dnieper River, ice forming around moored knarr. Frost coats rigging and shields. Slavic traders huddle near driftwood fires. Pelts and amber stacked on frozen ground, breath steaming in dawn light.

Scythian high pasture camp above treeline, felt tents anchored against mountain wind. Gold-adorned chieftain warms at central fire. Bronze horse-bits hang frozen. Caucasus peaks white beyond, thin air sharp, stars vast overhead.

Moche adobe pyramid rises from Peruvian coastal desert, rare cold fog rolling inland. Priests in wool mantles climb frozen steps. Pacific wind biting. Ceramic vessels frost-rimmed, distant Andes snow-capped, dawn grey and bitter.

Carnac stone rows emerge from Breton morning frost, megaliths white-coated. Atlantic wind cuts across frozen fields. Druids in wool approach alignments, breath clouding. Grey sea churns beyond, ice forming in tidal pools, stones endless.

Sassanian fire temple on Iranian plateau, eternal flame wavering in mountain wind. Snow swirls around Zoroastrian altar. Stone walls thick against cold. Priests in layered robes tend sacred fire, breath visible, peaks white around highland sanctuary.

Korean Silla fortress crowns frozen mountain ridge, timber palisades ice-coated. Guards in padded armor huddle near braziers. Tiled roofs snow-laden. Valleys white below. Bronze bells silent in still cold air, breath freezing instantly.

Viking Age Birka settlement on frozen Lake Mälaren, ice thick enough for sledges. Trade goods stacked near longhouses. Fur-clad merchants negotiate over steaming ale. Wooden wharves locked in ice, grey Swedish sky pressing low.

Incan Sacsayhuaman megalithic walls above Cusco, massive stones fitted tight against Andean winter. Snow dusts zigzag ramparts. Thin air burns. Llamas graze sparse grass. Priests in alpaca wool ascend frozen terraces, peaks endless white.

Germanic tribal gathering in Teutoburg winter, oak groves frost-heavy. Warriors in furs circle stone altar. Breath-fog thick around sacred fire. Bronze torcs gleam. Frozen stream nearby. Grey sky threatening more snow, ancient forest silent and cold.

Heian-era Kyoto temple garden buried in snow, vermilion torii gates stark against white. Frozen koi pond mirrors bare cherry branches. Monks in layered silk sweep stone paths, breath clouding. Distant Higashiyama peaks vanish in snowfall.
